args.body:
Fixes #57.

Use `(number - 1) * size` so page 1 returns the first page, matching the 1-based API contract stated in #57. Add regression tests for first and second pages, partial final pages, pages beyond the end, and empty input.

Validation: `python -m pytest -q` — 3 failed, 2 passed before the fix; 5 passed after the fix.

Remote file-content lookups returned empty results, so this change was based on the supplied local source and the issue description. Remote diff and CI still need review.
args.head: fix/pagination-57
args.title: Fix 1-based pagination offset (#57)
